commits.message: fix(deploy): configure cors, reverse proxy and storage

commits.author: DontPassAway
commits.message:
chore(deploy): run the staging stack on a local machine via cloudflare tunnel

Oracle signup is blocked for now. selfhost.yml swaps Caddy for a
Cloudflare quick tunnel and watch-stg.ps1 is the Windows counterpart of
deploy.sh + timer, so a Docker Desktop machine can serve stg meanwhile.
The AI Dockerfile path is now relative so both hosts share the file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: DontPassAway
commits.message:
chore(deploy): add oracle staging stack that tracks the stg branch

The ci.yml image is amd64 only while the Oracle Always Free VM is ARM,
so the VM builds from source instead: a systemd timer runs deploy.sh
every 2 minutes, which pulls stg, rebuilds api/ai and waits for the
API to answer. No GitHub secret or inbound SSH key is needed.

- docker-compose.yml: caddy, api, ai, postgres 17, libretranslate en/vi
- Dockerfile.ai: the AI service had no image yet
- bootstrap.sh: opens 80/443 in the Ubuntu iptables, swap, docker,
  random secrets in /opt/panelforge/.env, deploy timer
- README.md: cloud-init snippet, operations, first admin, limits

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(bible): save new revision before recording concept submission

When an artist submits concept art together with content changes, the
handler added a new revision and its ConceptSubmitted event in a single
SaveChanges. The revision points to the event (current_concept_event_id)
and the event points back to the revision, so EF Core rejected the save
with a circular dependency and the API returned 500 (BIB-10).

Save the revision first, then record the concept submission and save
again. If the second save fails the revision stays Draft in the design
queue and the artist can resubmit.

commits.author: chinsuhdh
commits.message:
feat(ai): make artist prompts manga style and follow writer story

artist.md v2 requires every image prompt to open with a manga/comic
style, forbids photographic wording, and follows the series style
rules when they define another style. ArtistAgent now also receives
the series story arc, chapter outline and scene summary so prompts
match the writer's plot, not only single script lines.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: chinsuhdh
commits.message:
feat(ai-config): add per-studio image API and cloudflare model list

- PUT /api/admin/workspaces/{id}/ai-image-provider picks a separate
  credential for thumbnails (must have an image model); text keeps its
  own source. A disabled image API blocks generation, no fallback.
- GET /api/admin/ai-providers/{id}/models lists Cloudflare text and
  image models with the stored token (token never leaves the backend).
- WorkspaceAiConfigDto gains imageProviderCredentialId; usage counts
  and delete conflicts consider both links.
- Thumbnails prepend a configurable manga style
  (AiService:ThumbnailStylePrefix) when the approved prompt has none.
- Migration AddWorkspaceAiImageProvider.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): drop VietQR wording on android for google play policy

Google Play's payments policy requires in-app digital goods to go
through Play Billing and forbids steering users to other ways to pay.
The unlock sheet and top-up dialog already hid VietQR on Android, but
two places still showed it there:

- Shop › "Tài sản của bạn" card said "Nạp Ví bằng VietQR"; Android now
  says top-ups go through Google Play.
- Điều khoản / Chính sách bảo mật / FAQ described VietQR and bank
  transfers. legalDocumentsFor(googlePlayBilling:) now swaps the payment,
  refund and payment-data sections for Google Play wording on Android;
  other platforms keep the VietQR text.

Also fix the FAQ claim that Đọc sau / Yêu thích are device-only: they
sync with the account since the library sync landed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): prepare android release for google play

- Sign release builds with an upload key from android/key.properties
  (git-ignored; template in key.properties.example). Without it the
  build still falls back to the debug key for local `--release` runs,
  but bundleRelease (the Play artifact) is refused.
- API base URL comes from --dart-define=API_BASE_URL; without it the app
  keeps the dev hosts (10.0.2.2 / localhost). bundleRelease is refused
  unless API_BASE_URL is an https URL, so a Play build can no longer
  point at the emulator host.
- usesCleartextTraffic moves from the main manifest to the debug and
  profile manifests: release only talks HTTPS.
- Google sign-in no longer invents a device-only "Reader session" when
  the Firebase exchange or /api/auth/external-login fails. That session
  had no server cookie, so wallet, reading and library sync all failed
  with 401 while the app looked signed in; the error is now shown on
  the login screen instead.
- CLAUDE.md documents the release command and requirements.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): unblock android builds broken by afterEvaluate on :app

`flutter build appbundle --release` failed at android/build.gradle.kts:23
with "Cannot run Project.afterEvaluate(Action) when the project is
already evaluated": the preceding evaluationDependsOn(":app") evaluates
:app first, so registering afterEvaluate on it is rejected. Pin the NDK
immediately when the project is already evaluated, otherwise after it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): refresh wallet when the wallet dialog opens

Opening Ví (from Cài đặt › Lịch sử giao dịch or the unlock sheet's
"Nạp thêm tiền vào Ví") showed whatever wallet state was loaded earlier,
so a balance or history change on the server (e.g. a top-up approved on
the web, or the backend fix that hides unapproved top-ups) only showed
up after visiting the Shop tab. The dialog now refreshes silently on
open, keeping the current data on screen while it loads.

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): refresh history after reading and show real wallet history

Found while testing signed-in flows on the Windows build:

- Profile > Lịch sử kept the old "10 ngày trước" entry after reading a
  chapter, although the progress was saved and synced (PUT history 200).
  The tab only redrew when librarySync.version changed, which happened
  on server merges only. Local library changes now bump the version too.
- Thông báo > GIAO DỊCH VÍ read a local cache that is almost never
  written, so it said "Chưa có giao dịch nào" while the wallet history
  listed the user's top-ups. It now uses GET /api/wallet/me like the
  wallet screen, with the cache as fallback.
- Unlock sheet showed "Số dư sau thanh toán: -10.000đ" when the balance
  is too low; the wallet can't go negative, so it now shows
  "Cần nạp thêm: 10.000đ".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): unblock unverified login, deep-link back and error text

Found while running the app against the local backend:

- Login with an email that is not verified yet only showed the 401
  message on the password form, with no way to enter or resend the PIN.
  LoginPage now switches to the PIN step on that 401 and offers
  "Gửi lại mã PIN" (POST /api/auth/resend-verification).
- ApiException.toString() returned "ApiException: ... (code: 401)",
  which many snackbars showed verbatim. It now returns the message only.
- Back arrows on series detail, reader, settings and legal pages called
  context.pop(); when the page was opened directly (deep link
  panelforge://app/series/<id>, post-login redirect) there was nothing
  to pop and the button did nothing. New popOrGo() falls back to a
  sensible parent route.
- ForgeSectionHeader added its own 16px left inset inside lists that
  are already padded, so headings on Thông báo / Đã tải sat 16px right
  of their content.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: MinhTHB
commits.message:
fix(mobile): consume google play topups only after server verification

- one app-wide billing service listens to the purchase stream from launch,
  so purchases are no longer handled twice (shop + dialog) or dropped when
  neither screen is open; results show once via the root ScaffoldMessenger
- buyConsumable(autoConsume: false) and consume after the backend verified
  the token; network/5xx errors keep the purchase and retry it on launch or
  login (backend is idempotent per token)
- handle canceled and pending purchases so the topup spinner stops
- disputes and receipts use the transaction orderCode (falls back to id)
- reload mobile-config when the app resumes so maintenance mode applies
  mid-session
